candidate.user_submission: This pikin na 59 months old. E dey cough or e dey get wahala to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. E no dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. E no dey weak or dey like say e no sabi anything. E dey fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything wey e chop. I count im breath for one full minute. As I dey count, di pikin calm. E no get chest indrawing. Dis cough don last for 3 days. Dem no get pulse oximeter for here. E no get recurrent wheeze. I count 40 breaths per minute. E no get stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze.
